Glance can articulate Zapps as the D0 commerce transport that sits above UCP: intent before the protocol even activates.

Glance's Physical AI Stylist (virtual try-on without a selfie or data upload) is the clearest answer to this trust gap that nobody is naming.

momentum_angles.angle: AI Chatbots Are Now the Highest-Converting Discovery Channel in Commerce
momentum_angles.coverage_summary: Adobe Analytics data from Prime Day 2026 showed AI chatbot-referred shoppers converted 40% better than search, email, or social. AgentCommerce covered the broader infrastructure (Salesforce Agentforce GA, Mastercard's first agentic payment in production). AI Ad Economy tracked OpenAI's Cannes debut and 1,400+ brands now advertising on ChatGPT. Modern Retail documented that AI-driven discovery at brands like Loftie nearly doubled from 1.5% to 3% within six months. The consensus: the discovery funnel now starts in AI chat.
momentum_angles.glance_counter_angle: Every publication treats AI chat as the new top of funnel. Glance's counter-angle: the funnel has a pre-chat layer. The 0.5 seconds before a user opens any app is an unclaimed discovery moment. AI chat requires deliberate intent (the user must open an app and type). Glance Zapps activate on passive intent — the moment the screen lights up. Prime Day's conversion data proves intent-matched discovery converts; Glance can publish data on lockscreen discovery-to-purchase at the moment of device pickup, framing it as the layer above AI chat.

Retail Dive noted Best Buy's risk of ceding brand control to AI intermediaries. The theme: every major platform is fighting to control the agent-to-purchase handshake.
momentum_angles.glance_counter_angle: The platform sovereignty debate assumes the battleground is between ChatGPT, Google, and Amazon. Glance's counter-angle: the OEM layer (Samsung, Motorola hardware) is the only commerce surface that is neither Apple, Google, nor Amazon. Glance's Brand AI Store is a first-party channel that bypasses the agent intermediary war entirely. While everyone argues about who owns the checkout handshake, Glance owns the device surface before any handshake begins.
